THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA
ORAL ORDER

The petitioners are before this Court calling in question proceedings in C.C.No.539/2012, pending before the II Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Hoskote, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A r/w. 34 of the IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

Learned counsel for the petitioners and respondent No.2 in unison submit that the parties to the lis were before the family Court in M.C.No.3040/2022 and during the pendency of the matter before the family Court, they have settled the dispute amicably among themselves by entering into memorandum of settlement.
Based upon the memorandum of settlement, they have parted their ways after obtaining the decree of divorce from the concerned Court.
The memorandum of settlement also recognizes the closure of the present proceedings.
A copy of the memorandum of settlement is also appended to the petition and a memo of settlement is filed before this Court to that effect.

3. The memo of settlement reads as follows:
"The Petitioners and the Respondents have amicably resolved the differences and dispute between them and the Respondent No.2 represented by her GPA Holder has no objection for allowing the above petition as settled in view/terms of the Memorandum of Settlement dated 22.07.2022 in MC No.3040/2022.

Therefore, the parties jointly pray that this Hon'ble Court may kindly take the instant memo of Mr. A. Krishnamurthy vs The State Of Karnataka on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133345730/
3 settlement on record and pass appropriate orders, in the interest of justice."

ORDER (i) The criminal petition is disposed.
(ii) The proceedings in C.C.No.539/2012, pending before the II Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Hoskote, stand quashed.
